ray_dalio.rationale: The plan correctly identifies the 'pain' (0% completion) and moves immediately to diagnosis and root-cause correction. By decomposing tasks into 2-leaf nodes, we are building a more reliable machine that reflects reality rather than our desires.

eliyahu_goldratt.rationale: Action-001 is the clear physical constraint; until the execution engine (D-1) functions, any marketing or high-level flow intelligence is irrelevant. We must subordinate the rest of the system to fixing this 'broken link' before moving to market constraints.

michael_porter.rationale: Operational effectiveness (fixing D-1) is necessary but not sufficient; the failure of LinkedIn outreach suggests a lack of differentiation. We must ensure the 're-run' of the audience phase focuses on a unique value proposition rather than just increasing volume.

amendments.amendment: Pivot outreach strategy to emphasize a unique value proposition (differentiation) rather than just doubling volume, testing against a specific buyer persona.

board_synthesis: The board agrees that fixing the execution engine (D-1) is the immediate priority to restore operational integrity. While Porter emphasizes differentiation in the commercial gate, all members support the sequential resolution of internal system failures before scaling outreach.
critical_constraint: Action-001: Domain 'D-1' execution failure (The primary bottleneck preventing all other system progress).
